//pglite: @electric-sql/pglite is declared below so scripts/check-migrations-build-the-schema.ts can replay every migration journal against an empty Postgres. Without it the guard falls back on Bun's auto-install, which is disabled whenever node_modules exists — i.e. it would quietly not run in CI. (A comment key inside devDependencies is NOT ignored: bun tries to resolve it as a package.)
//overrides: Security: force patched versions of transitive production deps flagged by `bun audit --prod` (ws via supabase-realtime; fast-xml-parser/builder via aws-sdk-s3).
